card.name: Linking words in plant and crop handling
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, of, near, by, with, a) inside horticulture or agronomy instructions, such as seed drying, stratification, lumber drying, soil moisture and ethylene ripening. They sit right before a treatment, condition or amount.

modes.label: Purpose or target after drying
modes.description: The word "to" after dry or air dry, leading to a goal or standard.

modes.label: Link words in seed or soil conditions
modes.description: Words like near, of, by, or a just before a condition, period or number in seed or soil text.
modes.example: Maximum soil compaction occurs when soil moisture is at or<< near>> field capacity (Figure 1) because

modes.label: Before a value or treatment
modes.description: A space or the word "the" or "with" before a temperature, concentration or treatment location.
